title.narrative: Green hydrogen for a decarbonised economy in Costa Rica (NAMA – Green H2 Costa Rica)

description.narrative: Costa Rica (CRI) aims to reach climate neutrality by 2050, however, the country's biggest challenge in its decarbonizing plans is decoupling from fossil fuels and their derivates in sectors like transport, industry and agriculture. The high renewable energy (RE) potential in the country implies a high possibility for green hydrogen (gH2) production to accelerate CR`s decarbonisation plan. The project aims at inducing a transformative change towards the application of gH2. The technical component will support the national government in creating enabling conditions for the production and consumption of gH2 and in the development of business models for its deployment in different sectors. The financial component is expected to comprise targeted incentive schemes for gH2 production facilities and off-takers by combining commercial financing with concessional funds. Approximately 30,000 tonnes of CO2e will be mitigated over the project’s implementation period.
